summary: CertificationEditAll is a user control for managing and editing certification records for students within an enrollment module. It displays a grid interface allowing batch edits, saves, and updates of certification details, including tracking status, dates, and numbers, with workflow controls and validation.
purpose: To provide administrators and authorized users with the ability to view, edit, and update multiple student certification records efficiently from a grid interface. Enables batch operations such as saving all changes or navigating to next sets of records, with business logic and validation embedded.

workflows.name: Batch Certification Edit and Save
steps: Load certifications for students based on filters and session context.
Display grid with editable fields for each certification: number, effective date, expiry date, status.
Allow edits to fields if not in read-only mode.
Track dirty rows with hidden fields for change detection.
Save all changes (cmdSaveAll) or save individual edits (cmdSave, cmdSaveEditNext) using StudentCertifications.StudentDetailsCertificateUpdate.
Handle validation: date formats, effective vs expiry date, required fields.
Show/hide Save All or Save/Cancel/Edit buttons based on user mode, row count, and EnrollmentID.
Redirect to Enrollment or EnrollmentEditAll pages after successful save or cancel, with updated query string parameters.
Bind or rebind data after update operations; set up JavaScript variables for client-side handling.

business_rules: Only allow editing if not in blnReadOnly mode.
Hide 'Save All' if in Add or single Edit mode.
Hide Save All/Edit Next buttons for short paginated lists (<14 rows).
Show/hide footer panel based on EnrollmentID.
Populate fields from existing certifications for matched StudentID and CertificationCodeID.
DropDownList for expiry date visible only for System Administrators.
Redirect only if there are no error messages after update.
Batch updates require dirty row detection via txtDirty field.
validations: EffectiveDate and ExpiryDate must be valid date formats.
ExpiryDate must be on or after EffectiveDate.
Client-side JavaScript declarations for date validation messages.
Show validation summaries via ValidationSummary1 control.
calculations: Sort direction and query string parameters are calculated for navigation and data presentation.
conditions: blnReadOnly disables editing controls and calendars.
EnrollmentID determines visibility of Save/Edit/Cancel panels and controls.
ShowGrad, ShowInactive, ShowWaived, SectionFilter, ActionFilter, CampusID, and CommentFilter are applied as input parameters for certification searches.
system_behavior: Loads certifications via search based on filter parameters.
Allows batch or individual saving of certification changes.
Tracks dirty rows for efficient database update.
Hides/shows UI elements based on user role, mode, and record state.
Registers client-side JavaScript for field validation and change detection.
Binds data to grid and handles UI event lifecycle: DataBound, RowDataBound, RowCommand, Prerender.
dependencies: JavaScript and ScriptManager for client operations
exceptions: Cancel data source selection if UserSession is null.
Do not redirect if validation errors or messages are present.
Handle casting and data binding errors gracefully.
content_gaps: No detailed field definitions for StudentCertification entity.
No explicit error handling or logging mechanism described.
Details on Service entity usage are limited.
No UI layout or markup included.
